## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The preview containment check must be fixed before merge: relative traversal and symlinks can expose files outside the selected home directory.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — With `home="/srv/home"` and `relative="../secret.txt"`, `preview` reads `/srv/secret.txt` instead of rejecting the outside path. `is_relative_to` checks lexical ancestry without resolving `..` or symlinks, so both traversal and an in-home symlink to an outside file bypass this check. Resolve the home and candidate paths before checking containment, read the validated path, and add regression tests for both bypasses; the existing rejection test covers only an absolute outside path. — Callers can read text outside the directory that the preview helper is intended to restrict access to.
